title: Sudden Tremors: Ancient Golem
summary: Open the runed chest before defeating the Ancient Golem to preserve the mission sequence.

roles.label: Everyone

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Destroying or opening the scripted runed chest marks the chest objective as complete.
Once that flag is set, the living golem emits an earthquake warning and camera tremor on its one-minute timer.
The source warns that killing the golem before opening the chest can leave the mission incomplete.

notes: Approval R019. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
Task-database gates and completion behavior are not present in this short controller. Confirm the chest-first path and verify recovery from an early golem kill before publication.
